items.text: Hypothesis: Drafting customer contract documents by hand for each new balcony or terrace order — Public clue: Sales representative job posting lists preparing customer contract drafts as part of the role (inferred from job description) (~6 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Chasing post-sale installation status and updating records for each installation — Public clue: Same posting describes post-sale monitoring of each installation (inferred from job description) (~5 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Scheduling installers and production slots for Kouvola and Helsinki orders — Public clue: Installer and production worker postings in Kouvola and Helsinki suggest hands-on order and installation scheduling (inferred) (~4 h/week, estimate)

Hypothesis: Re-keying dealer and partner order details as the Ryds Glas Swedish partnership scales — Public clue: Partnership announced to scale the Swedish business; partner-network growth can add order-handling volume (inferred) (~3 h/week, estimate)

blocks.text: Estimate: Hours per week are scenario estimates built from inferred job-ad descriptions, not measurements of Lumon's internal processes; an FTE conversion of hours/37.5 and a loaded cost of EUR 55,000 per FTE per year are also estimates. Public evidence only; the real numbers come from a conversation.

blocks.label: Note to the COO (with the card)
blocks.text: Hi, I came across Lumon's recent growth and the sales role asking for contract drafts and installation follow-up. We built a persona we call Tilaus-Tapio to explore whether that work is taking up real hours. It is only a guess from public job ads, so I'd genuinely like to know if it's close to what your team sees. Would you be open to a short chat about it?
